pages.name: A2
pages.title: Background Knowledge of Google My Activity Dashboard

elements.name: A2_intro_MyActivity
elements.html:
In the following section, we will ask you some general questions to learn more about your knowledge of the Google “My Activity” dashboard.

The Google “My Activity” dashboard is a service provided by Google that allows users to view, manage, and delete the activity data collected from their use of various Google services (such as Search, YouTube, Maps, Chrome, and more). “My Activity” organizes your past activity in a timeline and gives you control over what data is stored in your Google Account.

  • You can access the Google “My Activity” dashboard by visiting https://myactivity.google.com/ while signed into your Google Account.
  • You can also find it by going to your Google Account → Data & Privacy → History settings → My Activity.
  • “My Activity” allows you to view activity by date, Google product, and category. You can also delete specific items, delete activity in bulk, or turn on auto-delete for future activity.
You can learn more about the Google “My Activity” dashboard from the official help page: Click here

elements.html:
In the following section, we will ask you some questions to learn more about your usage of the Google “My Activity” dashboard, as well as how you interact with Google services that contribute to your stored activity. We will also ask a few questions regarding your cross-device Google usage.

What is a Google activity log?

It is the information Google collects based on your interactions with its products and services. These logs are stored in your Google “My Activity” dashboard and may differ across devices and products. (See the figure below)

It may include 🔍 Searches🌐 Websites visited📱 Apps used▶️ Videos watched🎙️ Voice and audio interactions📍 Location history

Logs may also include timestamps, device details, product information, and in some cases the content of your activity (e.g., what you searched for or watched).

Figure: Example representation of Google activity logs
Where do activity logs come from, and how are they stored?
When you are signed in
Google stores activity when you use services such as Search, YouTube, Maps, Chrome, and others while signed into your Google Account.
Across multiple devices
Activity may be stored from several devices at the same time if the same Google Account is signed in on them.
You can view and manage it
You can view, delete, or manage these activities by visiting https://myactivity.google.com.

elements.html:
In this part, you will be asked to install a browser extension that we designed for the research called ADA (Adaptive Data DAshboard). Follow the instructions given below.

🔒 Your privacy

You will NOT be required to share your Google activity data with us at any stage of the study. Our study involves interacting with a browser extension that runs entirely on your device and processes your data locally, without sending any information outside your browser.

What we DO NOT collect
✕ Name✕ Address✕ Email address✕ Date of birth✕ Phone number✕ Images✕ Videos✕ Contacts✕ Location data✕ ZIP/postcode✕ Links to social media accounts or posts
What we DO keep
Only logs of your interaction activity (clicks, navigation, install and uninstall timestamps) while using the extension. These do not include any raw data or personal information.
Please follow the steps below to install and set up the ADA browser extension.
1
Open Google Chrome on your desktop/laptop.
2
Log into your Google Account.
3
Open a new tab and visit: https://myactivity.google.com/ and keep the tab open.
4
Visit the extension installation link provided below:
Open extension link ↗
5
Click “Add to Chrome” → “Add Extension”.
6
Once installed, pin the extension to your browser toolbar.
